During the [[Outer Rim Sieges]] of the [[Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic]] undertook a '''siege''' of [[Boz Pity]] as the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] maintained several installations that allowed the Separatists to raid Republic territory. Due to the amount of raids and their devastation, the Republic counterattacked Separatist forces on Boz Pity, which resulted in a siege that became one of the most intense of the war, drawing in major leaders and fighters from both sides.<ref name="Collapse" /> After the [[Siege of Saleucami]], [[Jedi General]] [[Quinlan Vos]] moved [[Quinlan Vos's legion|his forces]] to Boz Pity,<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> where they emerged victorious. Vos was then redeployed to the [[Battle of Kashyyyk]].<ref name="TCW encyclopedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|The Clone Wars}}</ref>
